name: Organ
author: Simon Dalzell (Ivy Audio) / Versilian Studios / packaged for DAW
attribution: Organ sampled by Simon Dalzell of Ivy Audio, from VS Chamber Orchestra: Community Edition (VSCO-2 CE) by Versilian Studios (Sam Gossner, Simon Dalzell; sample cutting by Elan Hickler/Soundemote). CC0 1.0; credit encouraged.
desc: Soft church pipe organ (quiet registration, manual + pedal), sustained & looped. MIDI ~24-96. Best as a quiet drone/pad under piano or for hymn-like chords. | Playable MIDI 33-100 (A1-E7), 1 velocity layer. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity).
